title: Source-of-truth alignment
requirement: Use existing ARGON source-of-truth and ADR precedence; no competing authority is silently introduced.
acceptance_criteria: All assurance controls map to authoritative docs/ADRs or are explicitly proposed with conflict owner.

title: Named accountable owners
requirement: Every critical function has an accountable named owner and independent reviewer.
acceptance_criteria: No critical/high control lacks an accountable owner and review path.

title: Scope and intended use
requirement: Define launch facility types, users, clinical functions, non-goals, jurisdictions and hosting regions.
acceptance_criteria: Scope is approved and every excluded function/jurisdiction has an explicit rationale.

title: Stable requirement traceability
requirement: Give requirements, hazards, risks, tests, and evidence stable IDs.
verification_method: Automated matrix lint + sample trace walk
acceptance_criteria: IDs unique; each in-scope requirement has owner, acceptance criteria, verification path and gate.

title: ADR approval state
requirement: Proposed decisions are not treated as approved/implemented.
acceptance_criteria: Decision authority and date are recorded for each approved decision; no silent state transition.

title: Risk acceptance policy
requirement: Define who may accept which risks and expiry/compensating-control requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Every accepted risk has authorized approver, rationale, compensating controls and expiry; critical release controls cannot be waived by this gate.

title: Evidence integrity and retention
requirement: Evidence must be traceable, reviewable, appropriately protected and retained.
acceptance_criteria: Each PASS links to current artifact tied to build/environment with reviewer and approval where required.

title: AI-assisted changes governed
requirement: AI-generated decisions/code are proposals until reviewed and tested under same controls.
acceptance_criteria: No AI output self-approves an ADR, control, clinical interpretation or risk exception.

title: User need and acceptance
requirement: Every priority feature traces to a documented user need and measurable acceptance criteria.
acceptance_criteria: In-scope P0/P1 features have an identified user, use case, acceptance test and evidence of need.

title: Trust boundaries and data flows
requirement: Map all major components, trust boundaries, data classes, external flows and privileged paths.
acceptance_criteria: No in-scope flow or privileged pathway is undocumented; diagrams match actual proposed stack.

title: Domain/data ownership
requirement: Each domain has clear write ownership, invariants and cross-domain interaction rules.
verification_method: Domain map to workflow/data-map trace review
acceptance_criteria: No conflicting writer or orphan domain/workflow/data entity remains without approved resolution.

title: Failure and degradation design
requirement: Every critical workflow defines timeout, failure, retry, partial completion, cancellation and recovery semantics.
acceptance_criteria: Each critical workflow has documented failure path and user-visible state; no ambiguous silent success.

title: Technology choices and exit plan
requirement: Major technologies have current rationale, operating cost, alternatives, vendor lock-in and exit/migration approach.
acceptance_criteria: Each major choice has owner, current evidence, conditions/trigger to revisit, and migration/exit notes.

title: Environment and build reproducibility
requirement: Design a reproducible, isolated dev/test/staging/prod setup and record configuration provenance.
verification_method: Architecture review and clean-build prototype plan
acceptance_criteria: Build and deployment can be reproduced from versioned config without committed secrets.

title: Threat model coverage
requirement: Threat model covers data plane/control plane, integrations, support, jobs, backups and telemetry.
acceptance_criteria: Threats, abuse cases, mitigations, owners and verification tests exist for all major trust boundaries.

title: Identity and session lifecycle
requirement: Design secure authentication, session expiry/revocation, MFA for privileged access, and account lifecycle.
verification_method: Identity design review and abuse-case planning
acceptance_criteria: Account provisioning, suspension, recovery, revocation and privileged MFA behavior are explicit and testable.

title: Authorization model
requirement: Map roles, relationships, purpose-of-use, consent and actions to explicit policy decisions.
verification_method: Policy matrix review and decision-table generation
acceptance_criteria: Every sensitive operation has explicit allow/deny rules, default deny and a verification scenario.

title: Tenant isolation architecture
requirement: Define trusted tenant context and enforce isolation at applicable service and data layers.
acceptance_criteria: No client-controlled tenant selector is sufficient authority; cross-tenant access paths are enumerated.

title: Privileged/break-glass design
requirement: Emergency elevation has reason, scope, duration, alerting, audit and review.
acceptance_criteria: No unbounded silent elevation; expiry/revocation and post-use review are defined.

title: Data inventory and purpose
requirement: Identify data categories, purposes, roles, recipients, processing locations and retention needs.
acceptance_criteria: In-scope data flows and accountable controller/processor roles are documented and reviewed.

title: Jurisdiction applicability
requirement: Map applicable laws/contracts to actual launch scope and data flows.
acceptance_criteria: Each target jurisdiction has a documented applicability determination; unresolved issues are clearly blockers.

title: Intended clinical use and hazards
requirement: Define intended use, foreseeable misuse, hazard log, harm severity and mitigation ownership.
verification_method: Clinical safety workshop and independent review
acceptance_criteria: Relevant hazards have traceable requirements, mitigations and verification plans; unacceptable hazards block launch.

title: Data invariants and ownership
requirement: Specify invariants for identity, clinical records, money, audit logs, ordering and message idempotency.
acceptance_criteria: Every high-impact entity has invariants and tests planned for concurrency, duplicate, amendment and deletion behavior.

title: External standards profile
requirement: Specify exact protocol/version/profile, counterparty, terminology mappings, consent and error handling.
acceptance_criteria: No unqualified “supports FHIR/HL7/DICOM” claim; compatibility profile and counterpart test plan are explicit.

title: Business-approved SLO/RTO/RPO
requirement: Set service objectives and recovery targets from impact analysis, not aspirational guesses.
acceptance_criteria: Each critical journey/data tier has owner-approved measurable SLO, RTO and RPO or an explicit pending status.

title: Representative workflow design
requirement: Design for real roles, language, accessibility, interruptions and error recovery.
acceptance_criteria: Critical tasks and error recovery have testable criteria and representative-user validation plan.

title: Clean reproducible build
requirement: Build exact source revision in a clean controlled environment.
verification_method: CI clean build; dependency lock verification
acceptance_criteria: Build succeeds reproducibly and artifact is tied to commit/toolchain/config; no undocumented manual steps.

title: Unit tests for domain invariants
requirement: Test domain rules and calculations, not only line execution.
acceptance_criteria: Critical invariants have meaningful pass/fail assertions; material mutants or injected faults are detected.

title: Integration/contract tests
requirement: Test databases, queues, identity, object store and external APIs including version/error contracts.
acceptance_criteria: Critical contracts tested on accepted versions; incompatibility and timeout paths fail safely.

title: End-to-end critical workflows
requirement: Test representative workflows from authentication through persisted state and audit.
acceptance_criteria: All release-critical workflows pass, including validation, denial, cancellation, retry and partial failure.

title: Negative authorization tests
requirement: Exercise all sensitive operations with missing, wrong-role, wrong-tenant, expired and revoked credentials.
verification_method: Automated negative tests and adversarial review
acceptance_criteria: All unauthorized variants deny access and produce no sensitive side effects or data leakage.

title: Concurrency/idempotency
requirement: Test simultaneous edits, duplicate messages, retries, replay and out-of-order delivery.
acceptance_criteria: No silent lost update, duplicate clinical/financial effect, or invalid state transition.

title: SAST, dependency and secret checks
requirement: Run suitable static analysis, dependency vulnerability/licence checks and secret scanning.
acceptance_criteria: No untriaged critical/high finding; exceptions documented; exposed secrets rotated, not just removed.

title: Independent adversarial code audit
requirement: Perform adversarial/forensic review before a phase is marked IMPLEMENTED, consistent with ARGON L15.
acceptance_criteria: Build environment verified; independent audit artifact exists; all critical findings closed/retested.

title: Migration reversibility/reconciliation
requirement: Test migrations against representative scale and preserve invariants/traceability.
acceptance_criteria: Migration has backup/rollback or forward-fix plan; counts and critical fields reconcile to pre-approved criteria.

title: Financial exactness
requirement: Use exact monetary representation and explicit rounding/currency rules.
acceptance_criteria: No floating-point money; rounding, currency, tax, refund and ledger invariants are tested.

title: Audit event completeness and protection
requirement: Record relevant actor/action/subject/tenant/time/context/outcome; protect against silent alteration.
verification_method: Event schema tests, authorization tests, tamper test
acceptance_criteria: Critical mutations emit attributable audit events; unauthorized mutation/deletion is denied or detected.

title: Telemetry minimization
requirement: Prevent PHI, secrets and tokens from entering ordinary logs/metrics/traces/analytics.
verification_method: Synthetic canary scan of logs/traces/error reports
acceptance_criteria: Sensitive canaries absent from standard telemetry; any permitted exception is specifically approved and protected.

title: FHIR/HL7/DICOM contract conformance
requirement: Validate actual messages/resources against the chosen profiles and counterpart contract.
verification_method: Profile validators + partner sandbox tests + semantic review
acceptance_criteria: Version/profile and terminology pass; semantic/business rules and failure handling separately verified.

title: Form/input/error-state verification
requirement: Validate units, required fields, labels, keyboard/accessibility and safe error recovery.
acceptance_criteria: Critical tasks meet pre-approved success/error criteria; users can detect incomplete or stale state.

title: Artifact and dependency provenance
requirement: Know what source/dependencies/config produced each build and deployment artifact.
verification_method: SBOM/provenance generation and signature/registry checks as adopted
acceptance_criteria: Release artifact is traceable to source and dependency lock; provenance checks meet approved policy.

title: Penetration test
requirement: Independent tester examines exposed application, API, roles, tenant boundaries and critical workflows.
acceptance_criteria: No open critical issue and no unmitigated high issue contrary to risk policy; retest verifies fixes.
frequency: Before first production / major auth change

title: Clinical workflow safety validation
requirement: Qualified reviewer examines hazards, mitigations, defaults, alerts and failure/downtime behavior.
verification_method: Clinical scenario simulation with representative users
acceptance_criteria: Critical hazards have effective verified controls; residual risk decision and training are documented.

title: Patient identity and result association
requirement: Test wrong-patient prevention, duplicate merge, result routing, amendments and units.
verification_method: Synthetic clinical scenario suite + reviewer sign-off
acceptance_criteria: No wrong-patient association in critical scenarios; provenance/status/units and corrections remain intact.

title: Retention, deletion and rights workflows
requirement: Test retention, export/correction/deletion limitations, consent and legal holds where applicable.
verification_method: Privacy workflow tests and specialist review
acceptance_criteria: Behavior matches approved policy and law; no deletion that violates documented medical-record retention obligations.

title: Integration failure containment
requirement: Test vendor downtime, malformed payloads, auth expiry, duplicate delivery, retries and reconciliation.
acceptance_criteria: Failures are visible, bounded, retry-safe and reconcilable; no silent dropped or duplicated critical message.

title: Backup restore drill
requirement: Restore into isolated environment and verify functional and data integrity.
acceptance_criteria: Application workflows function; record integrity is checked; actual RTO/RPO measured against approved targets.

title: Rollback/forward-fix drill
requirement: Demonstrate safe recovery from bad application/config/schema release.
acceptance_criteria: Rollback or forward recovery works for the tested failure mode; data loss and irreversible effects are bounded.

title: Capacity and latency test
requirement: Measure expected peak/burst/soak with realistic workload and data shape.
verification_method: Load, stress, spike and soak test
acceptance_criteria: Approved SLOs met at business-approved load; saturation, bottlenecks and degradation behaviors understood.

title: Pilot usability and accessibility
requirement: Test realistic end-to-end tasks with representative clinicians and admin staff.
acceptance_criteria: Critical task success/error criteria met; confusing/misleading states and high-risk workarounds fixed.

title: Data transfer and vendor review
requirement: Review locations, sub-processors, access controls, contracts, cross-border transfer and breach obligations.
verification_method: Vendor/privacy assessment and qualified legal review
acceptance_criteria: All applicable transfers/vendors have an approved basis and controls; unresolved material issue blocks release.

title: Security/privacy/clinical incident tabletop
requirement: Exercise incident triage, containment, patient-safety escalation, evidence handling and communication.
acceptance_criteria: Owners can execute documented playbook; actions/communication paths and response timings are recorded.

title: Production-like migration rehearsal
requirement: Rehearse on representative data volume with downtime/dual-write approach as applicable.
acceptance_criteria: Reconciliation passes pre-approved thresholds; abort criteria and rollback/forward-fix are demonstrated.

title: Obligation-to-control evidence
requirement: For each applicable legal/contractual requirement, link obligation → control → test → evidence → reviewer.
acceptance_criteria: No claim exceeds available evidence; scope, jurisdiction, date and exclusions are clear.

title: Exact build and release record
requirement: Release is bound to exact source, artifact, configuration, migrations and evidence set.
verification_method: Release manifest review and artifact digest verification
acceptance_criteria: Candidate build is immutable/traceable; approvals refer to same version/environment.

title: Production approvals complete
requirement: Capture product, QA, security, operations, and applicable clinical/legal approvals for exact candidate.
acceptance_criteria: All required sign-offs completed by authorized distinct reviewers; applicability is evidenced.

title: Monitoring and alert response
requirement: Verify dashboards, alerts, routing, escalation, incident and clinical safety paths.
acceptance_criteria: Critical failures generate actionable alerts reaching the responsible owner within approved thresholds.

title: Production privilege and secret readiness
requirement: Review least privilege, service accounts, MFA, secret storage/rotation, key policy and break-glass monitoring.
acceptance_criteria: No default credentials/excessive permissions; emergency access is bounded and monitored; rotation path tested.

title: Audit retention and access
requirement: Production audit records are retained, protected and reviewable for defined obligations.
acceptance_criteria: Retention/access policy matches approved requirements; audit is not silently editable by normal admins.

title: On-call and incident runbooks
requirement: Named on-call, severity, escalation and system-specific recovery procedures are ready.
acceptance_criteria: Owners can find and execute the appropriate runbooks; no critical unowned alert or escalation.

title: Migration final reconciliation
requirement: Compare source/target counts, key relationships, critical fields and financial/clinical aggregates after migration.
acceptance_criteria: All pre-approved reconciliation thresholds met; discrepancies explained and approved by data/clinical owners.

title: SLO/error-budget review
requirement: Measure service health and journey-level SLOs in production.
acceptance_criteria: Breaches trigger documented action; aggregate uptime cannot hide critical journey failures.

title: Recurring access and risk review
requirement: Review users, privileged access, service accounts, break-glass events and accepted risks.
acceptance_criteria: Orphaned/excess access removed; overdue/expired accepted risks escalated and closed/reapproved.

title: Periodic restore and DR test
requirement: Reperform restore/DR exercise and measure current RTO/RPO.
acceptance_criteria: Actual achieved recovery meets approved target or remediation plan is escalated; data integrity verified.
frequency: At least annually and after architecture change

title: Vulnerability remediation cadence
requirement: Track vulnerability age and patch/retest with severity-aware SLAs.
verification_method: Recurring SCA/SAST/DAST scan and remediation audit
acceptance_criteria: No overdue critical vulnerability without an approved emergency exception; fixes are retested.

title: Post-market safety signal review
requirement: Review near misses, user complaints, adverse events and newly discovered hazards.
verification_method: Incident/feedback trend review with clinical lead
acceptance_criteria: Safety signals receive triage and risk re-evaluation; corrective action effectiveness is verified.

title: Evidence freshness and change triggers
requirement: Reassess evidence after material changes, incidents, expired reports or new jurisdictions/features.
verification_method: Scheduled evidence-expiry scan and change-impact review
acceptance_criteria: Expired/stale evidence cannot support a current production claim; revalidation work is assigned.
